column3: how it was established
the 1st read address; sets SR, r15, CCR, GBR, jumps to 0x06004040
static constructors, clears the BSS and SGL's system area, calls main
crt0 calls it; the state machine on the byte at 0x06063410
main's first call: slInitSystem, slDynamicFrame, the game's initialisations
reads the pad, resets on A+B+C+START (0x0600026C), then slSynch
state 1: logos (SEGALOGO, TMLOGO2, ADX1), the attract movie MV000M00, the title
state 3: New Game, Option (TTL.SPR, OPTION.SPR)
loads the tables, models, weapon sounds, the room's ATR and SF (NOWLOAD.SPR)
the rooms: room names, player, events, cutscenes (NM%02d%02d.SPR, MV%03dN%02d)
DEEPFEAR_01 on the backup memory
SAV_BG, DIALOG, SAVE
WRONG.SPR
events and in-engine cutscenes: MV%03dN%02d, EV%02d.ADX, SEBGM%02d.ADX
builds %s.NHD, %s.BG0, %s.NMO, %s.ADX from MVnnnNmm (no %s.SPR: no subtitles)
the AVI player: MV000M00.AVI, MV139M01.AVI
loads the SCU DSP's ADX decoder (256 words from 0x0605AB94) and its 8 channel records
writes the set channel records into DSP data RAM 2, starts the DSP
whether the DSP has finished
stops the DSP, writes a program through PPAF/PPD
writes DSP data RAM through PDA/PDD
TV mode & 31, system clock, SGL's handlers, SINIT, SYS_CHGSCUIM (mode 2 = 320x256 by its table)
unsigned r4 / r5 -> r0 (sh2emu: 0xFFFFFF9C/7 = 0x24924916)
sets or clears bit 7 of GBR+176; waits on VDP1's EDSR
waits for VBlank-OUT, sets the countdown, then slSynch's body
hands the slave its lists (SINIT), idles until the countdown GBR+19 goes negative
16.16 multiply: dmuls.l, xtrct (sh2emu: 3 x 0.5 = 1.5, -3 x 2.5 = -7.5)
writes 0x0605427C to 0x06000250, turns the slave on
the slave: polls FTCSR, calls the function at 0x060542C4
SGL's VBlank-IN handler (SYS_SETUINT 0x40)
SGL's VBlank-OUT handler (SYS_SETUINT 0x41)
SGL's level-0 DMA end handler (SYS_SETUINT 0x4B)
SGL's level-1 DMA end handler (SYS_SETUINT 0x4A)
SGL's level-2 DMA end handler (SYS_SETUINT 0x49)
stores the frame rate at GBR+18, installs SGL's interrupt handlers
